about_the_game:
An overhead perspective action-adventure game centered on "hero capture and diverse combat". Players experience a variety of gameplay modes, from single-player missions to multiplayer competitions, in the "Dream World". The feature is that powerful defeated enemies can be transformed into playable heroes to form an exclusive lineup.This demo unlocks 5 heroes for players to try out.

Hero System: The core is the "dynamic hero pool". In addition to initial characters, defeating elites/BOSSes or clearing levels gives a chance to capture enemies as heroes. Rare heroes require completing specific maps.This demo only unlocks 1 map for players to play on.

Core Gameplay

1. Single-player Mode : Story mode includes linear levels and BOSS battles, with limited heroes unlocked upon clearance; Roguelike mode features random maps, events, items, and enemy combinations.

2. PVP Battles : 1V1 fast-paced duels; 5V5 team competitions emphasizing division of labor; 20-player battle royale on a super-large map, where fragments can be picked up to unlock temporary heroes, and the last survivor wins.

3. Multiplayer PVE : 3-4 players team up to challenge high-difficulty dungeons, with hero star-up materials dropped.

This demo only unlocks the single-player mode for players to try this time.

short_description: DreamHero is an overhead action-adventure game focusing on hero capture and diverse combat. Players can turn defeated enemies into controllable heroes, experiencing single-player stories, Roguelike, 1V1, 5V5, 20-player battle royales, and cooperative dungeons, blending strategy and operational fun.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
